title: FigureLab: a browser-based tool for assembling publication-quality scientific figures
description:
FigureLab is a single-file, browser-based application for assembling publication-quality scientific figures from image data (microscopy, western blots, histology, gels, and clinical or specimen photographs). It runs entirely client-side with no installation, server, or internet connection required, so no image data ever leaves the user's computer.

Features include grid layout with drag-to-space gutters, per-panel image adjustments (brightness, contrast, gamma, levels, fluorescence LUTs, and multi-channel composites), two-point scale-bar calibration, an annotation system with undo/redo, and export to PNG, JPEG, WebP, TIFF, PDF, and SVG at publication DPI (up to 1200 dpi for line art). It also exports reproducibility scripts (R/Python), CSV panel metadata, and journal-style captions.
